Collision pairs uniquely fix a; three distinct roots require Q=x²+y²+z²+xy+xz+yz=0, and its q² zeros follow from nondegenerate ternary quadratic theory (char>=5); equality-plane intersection counts use 6≠0. Four distinct roots use six pair-equality hyperplanes. Subtracting the a=0 monomial moments and applying binomial inversion yields the q mod 24 table. Independent direct polynomial enumeration checked all a≠0 for eleven prime fields; extensions are handled by proof, not inferred from finite tests.
